historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (5y 23.2%, 3y 11.3%) diverges >30% from revenue (5.6% 3y) and EPS (2.1% 3y). Book value is compounding because REGN retained most earnings as a ~$18B cash and securities pile, not because the operating business grew at that rate -- equity CAGR is rejected as the growth anchor in favour of the 3-year revenue CAGR.
historical_growth.notes: FY2020-21 are inflated by the REGEN-COV COVID antibody (FY2021 revenue $16.1B incl. ~$7.6B REGEN-COV), so 5-year CAGRs flatter the base. Owner-FCF 3y CAGR (-15.9%) is far below reported FCF 3y CAGR (-2.7%): interest income on the cash pile rose from $160M to $717M and SBC+withholding stayed ~$1.5-2.0B, so a growing share of reported FCF is either interest on the balance sheet (counted in net cash instead) or paid out as stock compensation.

scenario_narratives.base: Dupixent keeps compounding through COPD and newer type-2 indications until US biosimilars arrive after the 2031 compound-patent expiry; EYLEA HD (8mg) holds the anti-VEGF franchise roughly flat in aggregate as EYLEA 2mg erodes to biosimilars and Roche's Vabysmo; Libtayo and the bispecifics (linvoseltamab, odronextamab) add low-single-digit points of growth; the pipeline replaces part but not all of the Dupixent profit share in 2032-33. R&D intensity eases from ~41% of revenue as sales outgrow it, so adj. EBITDA margin recovers from 34% to ~39% before the LOE dip. Revenue ~$21B by FY2031, ~$21B in FY2035.
scenario_narratives.bull: Pipeline delivers: a second positive itepekimab COPD trial, fianlimab+cemiplimab in melanoma, Factor XI anticoagulants and the obesity muscle-preservation combos reach market; Dupixent COPD and new indications push the profit share well above consensus, and biosimilar erosion of a complex IL-4Ralpha antibody in dermatology/respiratory proves slow and partial. EYLEA HD prefilled syringe and extended dosing defend share against Vabysmo. Revenue compounds ~9% to FY2031 and keeps growing through the LOE; margins expand to ~41.5% on operating leverage over a stable R&D budget.
scenario_narratives.bear: The anti-VEGF franchise shrinks faster than EYLEA HD can offset (aflibercept biosimilars plus Vabysmo, and Medicare Part B negotiation under the IRA from 2028); Dupixent growth slows as competing type-2 biologics and oral agents arrive, then US biosimilars take share sharply from 2032; key pipeline readouts fail (as one of the two itepekimab COPD trials already did in 2025), leaving R&D spend high against a shrinking base. Revenue is roughly flat to FY2030 and falls ~15% through the LOE; margins compress to ~30%. Even here the $17.8B net cash (~$143/share) cushions the downside.

valuation_philosophy.summary: House basis values REGN on owner FCF -- reported FCF less SBC and net-share-settlement withholding taxes, less interest earned on the $17.8B cash and securities pile (which is added back as net cash instead). On that basis the operating business converts only ~13% of revenue to owner FCF today, versus 28% reported, because R&D is ~41% of revenue and equity comp ~10%. The valuation hinges on (1) how much of the Dupixent profit share survives the ~2031 US patent expiry and (2) whether margins recover as revenue outgrows a ~$6B R&D budget. Net cash is ~19% of the market cap and floors the downside.
key_risks_to_valuation: Dupixent US compound-patent expiry (2031) and the speed of biosimilar erosion of the Sanofi profit share
EYLEA 2mg biosimilar erosion and Vabysmo share gains outpacing EYLEA HD
IRA Medicare price negotiation (Part B selection from 2028) on EYLEA/Dupixent
Pipeline readout risk (itepekimab COPD, fianlimab, Factor XI, obesity) given R&D at ~41% of revenue
Equity-comp withholding taxes are lumpy (FY21-25 range $446M-$1,033M), so year-to-year owner FCF is noisy
Capital allocation: the $17.8B pile valued at book assumes it is not destroyed in M&A

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 541.00-859.34
data_sources.financials: REGN_Metrics.csv (SEC XBRL, FY2007-Q2 2026); SEC companyfacts API (CIK 872589) for marketable securities, finance lease, interest income on debt securities, equity-award withholding taxes, buybacks, diluted shares, cash taxes paid
data_sources.qualitative: REGN_Analysis.json not yet available at build time; scenario axes from filings and general knowledge of Regeneron's franchises and pipeline

inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted-average shares, Q2 2026 10-Q (three months to 2026-06-30), 106.0M. Held FLAT because SBC plus net-share-settlement withholding taxes are fully expensed in the flows; buybacks (FY2025 $3,438.6M, H1 2026 $1,963.7M) are the cash mechanism funding the flat count, i.e. REGN is a repurchaser and the flat count is paid for, not a convention.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 10-K (SEC XBRL): ShareBasedCompensation cash-flow add-back $993.7M + PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation $532.1M (financing) = $1,525.8M. REGN publishes no combined figure (its non-GAAP reconciliation adds back SBC only), so the two lines are summed. Withholding taxes are lumpy (FY21-25: 1,032.7 / 445.7 / 700.6 / 1,029.1 / 532.1).
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Net cash company so WACC = cost of equity: US 10y ~4.3% + beta ~0.75 x ERP 5.0% = ~8.0%. No ad-hoc premium for Dupixent/EYLEA concentration or patent cliffs -- that risk is carried explicitly in the scenario revenue paths and weights (charged once). Same WACC in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP: operating lease cost ($35.8M FY25) already sits inside operating expenses and hence inside EBITDA; operating lease liabilities ($266.8M) are therefore NOT in net debt. The $720.0M finance lease (facility lease with purchase option, current at 2026-06-30) is treated as debt and included in total_debt. One treatment, no double count.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route (dcf-methods routing: profitable, cash-generative US operating company; not a bank/insurer/REIT/holdco). No prior DCF in Reports/ (a stale Jan-2026 REGN_DCF_Model.xlsx sits in research/REGN/ outside Reports and was not used) -- fresh build. NET CASH: cash & equivalents $2,455.8M + current marketable securities $5,538.8M + non-current marketable securities $9,828.3M = $17,822.9M (Q2 2026 10-Q, 2026-06-30); debt = senior notes $1,986.6M + finance lease $720.0M = $2,706.6M. Because the $17.8B pile is added to EV, the $716.8M FY2025 interest income on debt securities is stripped from the FCF base (owner FCF = 4,080.5 - 1,525.8 - 716.8 = 1,837.9). Owner-FCF margin FY2025 12.8% vs reported 28.4%: SBC+withholding (10.6pp) and interest income (5.0pp) are the gap. ANALYSIS JSON: REGN_Analysis.json was not yet written when this was built (concurrent agent); scenario axes are drawn from the filings and general knowledge of the franchise (EYLEA/EYLEA HD vs aflibercept biosimilars and Vabysmo; Dupixent profit share from Sanofi and its ~2031 US compound-patent expiry; Libtayo; pipeline incl. itepekimab COPD, fianlimab, linvoseltamab/odronextamab, Factor XI, obesity). Re-check narratives against the Analysis JSON once it lands. Price is a regular-session close, not after-hours. Year-1 sanity: base Y1 owner-FCF margin ~12.8%, matching the FY2025 component actual (12.8%) -- nothing one-off carried forward.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +13% on H1 2026 revenue +17.8% y/y (7,896.1 vs 6,704.3) with H2 lapping a stronger H2 2025; Dupixent profit share and EYLEA HD growth offset EYLEA 2mg biosimilar erosion. Growth fades to 5% by FY2030 as Dupixent matures, then FY2032-33 decline as US Dupixent biosimilars arrive after the 2031 compound-patent expiry, partially offset by pipeline launches; FY2035 back to terminal 2.5%.
base.margin_rationale: Adj. EBITDA (GAAP operating income + D&A + SBC) was 47.7% FY22, 40.8% FY23, 38.4% FY24, 35.7% FY25, 34.0% H1 2026 -- compressed by R&D at ~41% of revenue and the high-margin EYLEA 2mg decline. Base recovers 1pp/yr to 39% by FY2031 as revenue outgrows R&D, gives back 2.5pp through the Dupixent LOE (the profit share is the highest-margin revenue line), settles at 37%.
base.sbc_rationale: SBC 6.9% + withholding 3.7% = 10.6% FY2025; H1 2026 SBC 6.3% with only $80.8M withholding. 10.0% Y1, gliding 0.2pp/yr to 9.0% -- REGN's equity-comp intensity has been stable, so no faster decline is assumed.
base.capex_rationale: Capex 6.3% FY25 and 6.0% H1 2026 on the US manufacturing/fill-finish build-out; tapers to 4.5% maintenance-plus by FY2033. D&A rises from 3.8% as the new plants enter service.
base.tax_rationale: GAAP ETR 13.9% FY25 (725.8 / 5,230.7). FY2025 cash taxes $1,253M were elevated by final TCJA transition-tax installments and Sec.174 R&D capitalization; OBBBA restored domestic R&D expensing. Cash rate 14% FY26 ramping to 16% (Pillar Two floor / GILTI) on operating EBIT.
base.wc_rationale: Negative capture: receivables (Sanofi/Bayer collaboration receivables and wholesaler AR) plus inventory far exceed payables, so growth consumes ~20c of working capital per $1 of incremental revenue; the sign flips to a release in the LOE years automatically.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% because the dominant profit source (Dupixent profit share) has a dated loss of exclusivity inside the 10-year horizon and the anti-VEGF franchise is already eroding -- the replacement thesis rests on pipeline readouts that have mixed history (itepekimab split result). Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent wins at once (pipeline hits, slow biosimilar erosion, EYLEA HD defence). Base 50%: the most likely path is partial replacement of the Dupixent profit share.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
